name: Status effect
description: Descriptive conditions that may affect a character or creature

fields.description: minor pain causes -1 on the next demanding physical action.
prolonged effort and travel are more difficult until resting.
-1 against the next fear or intimidation effect.
loses a small amount of HP after strenuous actions until treated.
takes recurring fire damage until the flames are extinguished.
movement and Speed-based actions are reduced until warmed.
sight-based actions fail or suffer a major penalty.
cannot hear speech, warnings, or sound-based effects clearly.
Constitution-based resistance is required as the poison progresses.
MD is reduced until the effect ends.
Strength-based actions suffer a penalty.
has difficulty distinguishing allies, enemies, or directions.
cannot willingly approach the source of fear without succeeding on a roll.
temporarily loses the ability to take normal actions.
voluntary movement is impossible until the condition is broken.
speech and voice-dependent abilities cannot be used.
the body is slowly turning to stone and requires urgent intervention.
An outside will occasionally contest control of the subject.
a magical sign allows a hostile creature or effect to track the subject.
cannot be seen normally but still makes sound and leaves traces.
restores a small amount of HP at the end of each turn.
may reroll one chosen die, after which this status ends.
The subject loses track of their surroundings and is disadvantaged on the next action requiring sustained attention.
Alcohol impairs coordination and judgment until rest or suitable treatment.
Drugs, alchemical substances, fumes, chemicals, or similar non-alcoholic substances alter perception or reactions; the exact effect depends on the substance.
Illness drains the subject and makes prolonged effort more difficult.
The subject is deeply focused; interruption ends the sought benefit and leaves brief disorientation.
The subject is lying on the ground, limiting movement and defense until they stand.
Bindings, terrain, or another force severely limit the subject’s movement.
{{ creature.generator.name }} holds the subject in place until the grip is escaped or broken.
The subject is unaware and cannot take deliberate actions until consciousness returns.
The subject cannot breathe adequately and requires air before the condition becomes life-threatening.
Prolonged lack of food weakens the subject and makes further exertion difficult.
Prolonged lack of water causes weakness, dizziness, and increasing difficulty with exertion.
